mentions.name: Datalog writebacks through derived columns
mentions.description: This is a client-side technique for enabling writebacks through derived (computed) columns in Datalog queries: any value appearing anywhere in a query — including string-transformed, concatenated, or arithmetic derivations — can be edited back to the underlying data, and the approach should work with any Datalog-based database. For example, a movie's title and rating can be edited through a derived card column.
mentions.source_excerpt: Datalog writebacks through derived columns. Any query. Any cell. And probably any datalog-based database too, it's just a client-side trick.
